name: AI Adoption Strategy VR
summary:
Which AI idea should your business try first?

Lead an AI pilot recommendation at a fictional retailer. You have $50,000 and 12 weeks. Choose a business priority, then hear three department heads adapt proposals for staff training, customer messages and stock planning.

Ask questions in your own words, interrupt to clarify and compare the case facts. Explain what you would test, who would lead it and how you would judge success. Respond to a new problem, then reflect with an AI mentor in a separate room.
